pred_ddx.label: Metastatic colon cancer with Sister Mary Joseph nodule

The biopsy of the umbilical lesion demonstrating well-differentiated, infiltrating adenocarcinoma supports this diagnosis. The presence of a mass in the right hypochondrium and the findings on contrast-enhanced abdominal CT further support the diagnosis of metastatic colon cancer with a Sister Mary Joseph nodule.
